change: Use an agent-VM-stable private lexical module resolver name. Each page keeps its own resolver closure, import map, module namespace, globals and security/fetch checks; no page is executed speculatively. The former per-ModuleHost suffix made identical transformed sources differ across navigations in an already shared VM.
scope: Repeat-module source/code-cache reuse within one agent VM. This neither persists native optimized JIT code across processes nor precompiles the first visit to a site.

disk_cache_probe.result: JSScript construction rejects the tested ordinary local cache directory: it is not a data vault. No persistent bytecode cache is enabled, and no JSScript path without that platform requirement is claimed.

microbenchmark.workload: Synthetic 4000-function module, original module loader and thread-local VM-group adapter; 12 fresh realms per process, two sequential fresh processes per case. All cold and warm samples retained. Reported warm statistic uses realms 1–11, after realm 0 populates the cache.
microbenchmark.endpoint: Native module evaluate call, including source supply, compilation/linking and trivial module execution; not isolated parser time or a page load. Functions are defined but not exercised to force a JIT warm-up.
microbenchmark.inference: The stable-name advantage nearly disappears with JSC_useCodeCache=false; combined with the native CodeCache implementation, this supports source-code-cache reuse as the explanation. There is no direct native cache-hit counter.
microbenchmark.initial_parallel_diagnostics: cache-probe-stable.log and cache-probe-changing.log were run concurrently and are retained separately; they are not included in the sequential case statistics.

warm_reload_limitations: The first ordinary-window attempt was stopped by the optimized-site allowlist before a document loaded. Later private profiles explicitly allow navigation and use the same proxy policy.
Both frozen control and candidate reloads fail to re-establish the author bootstrap-ready marker. A missing archived popover module is observed. They time out and supply no valid reload speedup.

A live candidate reload likewise fails the bootstrap-ready gate, despite a complete document and no reported native/JavaScript errors. The cause remains unresolved; isolated control/candidate frozen failures do not establish that the optimization caused it.
Native input/audit/reload probes add observation overhead. No physical presentation or CPU-instruction acceptance claim is made.

live_query.answer: The capital of Italy is Rome (Italian: Roma). 🇮🇹
live_query.scope: Diagnostic: live anonymous page, native click/text input in Vox, CDP click/text input in Brave, 250 ms audited answer observation; identical SOCKS route, cold private profiles/cache, 5 s ready settle; no instruction or frozen-response acceptance claim.

headless_smoke.metric: sampled sum of process-tree RSS; shared pages may be counted twice

limitations: This is a compile-cache eligibility improvement with passing module/realm correctness checks, not a demonstrated ChatGPT page-load or execution-time speedup.
The synthetic module result cannot be extrapolated to the 3 MB homepage, networking, DOM/layout, authentication or conversation service work.
The working startup/blocking policy is unchanged. No additional JavaScript prefetch, hidden page execution, JIT-threshold tuning or private disk-cache workaround is shipped.
Experimental orchestration files evolved between diagnostics. Per-run fingerprints and final sources are retained; completeness of every intermediate script version is not claimed.
Initial native cache-probe compilation used an Objective-C block where a C callback was required; its failed guard and the corrected callback implementation are retained.
